correctness.rationale: At the equilateral family the softmax weights are p=e^(3β/2)/(e^(3β/2)+2) on self and q=1/(e^(3β/2)+2) on neighbors. Radial pre-normalized factor 1-hK>0, K=1-3q. Direct differentiating tangential softmax gives δt_i=q(2+3β)/4 Σ_{j != i}(δ_i-δ_j); shape derivative L=1+3q(3β-2)/4 and neutral rotation eigenvalue 1. The double transverse multiplier λ=(1-hL)/(1-hK) satisfies |λ|<1 iff h S(β)<2, S=K+L=2+9(β-2)/[4(e^(3β/2)+2)]. S has one maximum because its derivative sign is 2+(4-3β/2)e^(3β/2), with exactly one zero >2. This proves the unique sharp h_c and two flip-neutral β boundaries for h_c<h<1, without asserting nonlinear bifurcation at λ=-1. Twelve direct finite-difference perturbations of the full 3-token normalized map agree with the double eigenvalue at six β values and two h values.

originality.rationale: This is a sharp transverse Jacobian and reentrant sharpness classification for full (unmasked) repulsive softmax on a regular triangle. Altafini’s 2026 positive-dominant-value hypotheses exclude V=-I; Gao–Yang–Chen 2026 treats negative values and regular polygons but apparently uses diagonal-masked attention in the relevant model. A first-order reduction of full attention to masked attention with β-dependent effective residual step is possible at equilateral states, and could make part of this a corollary of an exact masked polygon multiplier theorem. Its primary full text could not be inspected, so the priority judgment is qualified rather than claiming a definitive separation. The additional unique-maximum/return-stability threshold is not stated in accessible material.
